contracts.identity: Original canvas() allocates each real native canvas/context at the same point. Only its private opaque base paint changes; no cached canvas is replaced, pooled, cleared or evicted.
contracts.metadata: Native context attributes, current path, transform, stack, smoothing and final fillStyle must compare exact. putImageData is admitted only on the fresh source-owned identity-transform, unclipped, alpha1 source-over CPU context.
contracts.coercion: All original public routes and argument coercions run in their original order. Existing primitive admission, private palette/grain/cache provenance and every native descriptor watch remain; all new ImageData methods/data/typed-array descriptors are watched.
contracts.ownership: Original OWN scope arrays/order unchanged, with all active scopes falling back. Native context.canvas owner proof preserved for native/fake/Proxy/wrong-owner contexts. No productive handle or ImageData escapes.
contracts.observer: Before/after native/prototype/Map/Set/grain/descriptor observers retain original fallback. Newly observed ImageData methods/data hooks must force original painting with identical callback traces. No universal hostile pre-module reflection authentication claimed.
contracts.fallback: Original GPU/Node/unsupported/foreign input and native observer paths. No changed1536MB guard, original assertion, RNG/audio/clock or quality policy.
contracts.lifetime: One1024byte temporary per admitted base, no persistent image/source handle or new canvas registry. Byte count is cumulative logical temporary bytes, not native resident bytes.
contracts.paletteLifetime: Every dictionary is null-prototype and private, populated only after the unchanged source-owned palette/grain/cache/native admission. Each color is an already-proved own opaque primitive string. Duplicate equal colors map to identical bytes. Recompile on each original new tile; original memo hits and resets, later palette mutation, foreign getters/Proxies and all original fallbacks retain their original behavior. No dictionary survives in a public canvas or persistent palette cache.
contracts.allocationOnly: Private cache hits and their original first-successful recipe/state are preserved. Native Map/Set/grain identity and every old admission guard remain. No cached array is assumed immutable from identity alone; source ownership and no foreign callback epochs are still required.
contracts.paintOrder: Original row-major native calls, exact native canvas/context/state/path/metadata and native fractional overlays; no image publication, color conversion, speculative flushing, pooling or early scratch retirement.
contracts.observerBirth: Full grain/cache native epoch checked before canvas allocation and before hoisting; Array iterator-chain methods/parents watched. Public scope/GPU/foreign/coercive and captured native/fake/wrong-owner paths remain original.
